findings.source_quote:
When all Thy mercies, O my God,
    My rising soul surveys,
    Transported with the view, I’m lost
    In wonder, love and praise.
findings.suggested_fix:
The stanza is translated with several grammatical and idiomatic problems ("Mi alma que se eleva las examina", "Transportado con la vista"). Provide a fluent, faithful Spanish rendering that preserves the poetic sense. Suggested fix (preserve poem markup and emphasis tags):

Cuando contemplo todas Tus misericordias, oh Dios mío,
Mi alma en ascenso las contempla,
Transportado por la visión, me pierdo
En maravilla, amor y alabanza.
